notes.title: Official Release!
notes.content:
Awesome News! After another 2 months' development, we are now excited to announce the final release of Evolution VR! Here are the updates: 

New levels and scenes
8 more levels are added with 2 new scenes, bringing you brand new feelings.

New DIY room
DIY room has been redesigned for you to easily browse and use body-parts.

Game mode changed
There are no bosses any more. Just grow up to a certain size and you'll pass the level!

New body parts with skills
Now you can use your creature's skills that come with special body parts to bring more fun to the fights!

 Shark Mouth - Use skill "Suck" to draw nearby enemies to you
 Electric Sac - Use skill "Electric Shock" to shock your enemy, dealing damage
 Jet Sac - Use skill "Dash" to dash for a short distance, especially helpful when you are chasing or escaping from enemies
 Gas Bomb - Use skill "Gas Bomb" to release gas into an area, dealing damage to enemies nearby
 Lure Worm - Use skill "Lure Worm" to eject a worm, which attracts enemies around, and poisons the one eating it
 Bubble Sac - Use skill "Bubble" to stun enemies around


New enemies with special skills
Instead of enemies that behave very much alike, we added new creatures with special skills. e.g. they may turn invisible and attack you by suprise, or explode after death. And there are more for you to find out.

Functional scene objects
Like Jellyfish or special underwater plants. Be careful when you wander around them!

Optimizations
Various kinds of optimizations, including performance opt, effects opt, UI and interaction opt, etc.

Miscellaneous
Support for MR video recording and option for game data reset. (thanks to your suggestions from the forum)
Also, we've added a move function (use thumpad on left controller) for you to move forward in game scene. There will be no more creatures out of reach!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey guys, we've just pushed an update to optimize the scene view of the last level, and also included some performance optimizations.
Please stay tuned for future updates and releases! And remember we always welcome suggestions and criticisms that will help us make the game better!
